stock.description: Easou Technology Holdings Limited, founded in 2005 and based in Shenzhen, China, offers a comprehensive suite of digital services. These include digital marketing solutions, an online platform for reading, the publication of online games, and other personalized digital content recommendation services. The company operates the Easou Recommendation Engine, an online system designed to connect various stakeholders such as digital content creators, media outlets, users, advertisers, and telecommunications operators. Additionally, its offerings comprise the Easou Reading App, a dedicated platform for online literature, Easou H5 Pages for accessing online literature via mobile browsers and webpages, and Win Ads, an intelligent platform specifically for advertising services.
